sources.text:
Lake Kirikumäe (Estonian: Kirikumäe järv) is a lake in Estonia. It is located in the village of Kirikumäe in Võru Parish, Võru County.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 63.0 hectares (156 acres). The lake has an average depth of 2.5 meters (8 ft 2 in) and a maximum depth of 3.5 meters (11 ft). It is 1,010 meters (3,310 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 3,200 meters (10,500 ft). It has a volume of 1,536,000 cubic meters (54,200,000 cu ft).
